rationale: In both stronger continuations Bxa8 Rxa8 spends a bishop on the original a5 pawn after it has promoted. The promoted piece contributes no earned material to that comparison. Before the later Kxh4 the decision still trades a bishop for a pawn, just as Bxa7 Rxa7 does after g5. The two lines differ in counterplay, but the claim of a newly costly pawn interception is not established.
